legs.proof: THE MANIFEST CATCH, closed BEFORE any build. BEFORE: lambda-source-map.json:633 declared for opal-portal-authorizer a files array of exactly ONE entry, index.mjs. AFTER: the array lists index.mjs AND originVerify.mjs; the edit asserted uniqueness (exactly 1 textual match) before writing and the file re-parses as JSON. WHY IT MATTERS AND WHAT IT PREVENTED: the build packages only what this array names. A pure move that put the two-slot read in a new module without this edit would have shipped a zip whose index.mjs imports a file that is not in it -- MODULE_NOT_FOUND at cold start, on EVERY invocation, on the authorizer that currently guards 69 of 72 routes on the HTTP API including the nine TO-OP-S-2 attached an hour ago. That is a TOTAL OUTAGE produced by a refactor that reads as clean in every source diff, and the manifest is the only surface on which it is visible beforehand. The new module carries a WARN header saying so, so the next person extracting into this Lambda meets the rule at the file rather than in a ledger. ALSO OBSERVED AND NOT YET REMEDIED (separate from this limb): the same entry's last_deployed_commit 5585e9c6b4 and last_deployed_at 2026-05-14T22:26:21Z are ALREADY STALE -- TO-OP-S-3 redeployed this Lambda on 2026-09-03 and the manifest still names a May deploy, so the drift predates limb 2a.
